limitations: Cold launch samples measure process launch to the first verified RESULT record with a monotonic clock; the OS filesystem cache is warm after the correctness phase and is not dropped (no root cache purge).
Steady per-batch times include fixed platform-thread start/join cost for the shared-4 and monitor kernels; the thread count is fixed at 4 per batch.
Normalized ns/op is batch elapsed time divided by the documented operation count; it must not be read as individual operation latency.

The Catty retained heap observation is process-wide live Go-managed heap (including runtime structures); the OpenJDK value is post-collection Java heap occupancy. The two heap metrics have different runtime scopes.
OpenJDK steady numbers come from fresh JVM processes with a fixed warmup; Catty interp/AOT runs have no JIT. The comparison is the runtimes as shipped, not equivalent generated machine code.
Peak RSS on Darwin is reported by wait4 ru_maxrss in bytes; on Linux ru_maxrss is in KiB. A /usr/bin/time -l/-v fallback exists when os.wait4 is unavailable.
Only one host/CPU was measured; no CPU pinning or cgroup isolation was applied.

buildBoundaries.artifactPerCattyMode: standalone executable plus embedded image JSON
buildBoundaries.compilation: javac --release 21 -g over the checked-in sources, once
buildBoundaries.packaging: catty build reads the class directory, generates Go source and links the standalone executable; its wall time includes image generation, the generated Go package compile and the link

opDefinitions.app: one visit over one node of the deterministic graph: field/array reads, transient allocation, AOT caller -> interpreted Hot.mix -> AOT Callback
opDefinitions.calls-mixed: one AOT Calls.crossingKernel -> interpreted Hot.mix -> AOT Callback crossing chain
opDefinitions.calls-static: one direct static invocation of Calls.directTarget(int, int)
opDefinitions.calls-virtual: one virtual invocation through Calls.Base, alternating Calls.Alpha and Calls.Beta receivers
opDefinitions.memory-alloc: one escaping Escape object plus its int[4] payload retained in a ring
opDefinitions.monitor: one synchronized Counter.bump() increment, ops summed over four fixed threads
opDefinitions.reflect-invoke: one invocation of one cached Method via Method.invoke, including boxing; the lookup happened before warmup and outside the timed window
opDefinitions.reflect-lookup: one public Class.getMethod(name, parameter types) lookup by name
opDefinitions.shared-1: one read-modify-write of a shared int[] cell plus a field update, one thread
opDefinitions.shared-4: the same shared-array/field operation, ops summed over four fixed threads
